title: Workout Relief Amount on a FlexLine Late Fee
content:
**Clause — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The workout relief is the largest late fee on the line (of equal amounts, the most recently booked), waived in full. The relief is rounded to the cent; every rounding to the cent here takes an exact half cent to the even cent.

The late fee chosen is also the fee the relief entry is booked against. All late-fee entries on the line count, whatever their date.

## Worked cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Late-fee entries on the line | Fee relieved | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 25.00 (January), 22.00 (April) | the 25.00 entry | 25.00 USD |
| 18.75 (March), 25.00 (June), 25.00 (September) | the 25.00 entry booked in September, the more recent of the two equal fees | 25.00 USD |
| 12.40 (May) | the 12.40 entry | 12.40 USD |
